rule: Each magenta mark at the top edge emits a stream that falls through orange background. When red lies directly below, the stream paints the row above the red horizontal run containing the hit cell, extended by one cell on each side and clipped to the grid. It then splits into two streams that fall from both ends of that painted row. Red cells are never overwritten, and streams with no obstacle run to the bottom edge.
scope: Magenta streams fall through orange background and wrap/split over red horizontal runs. Random widths 6..30, heights 8..30, one to four sources of length 1..2. Separated mode samples horizontal/vertical bars; clustered mode adds connected L-shaped obstacles. Original fixture segments preserve touching arrangements and boundary cases.

authored_scope: Supported: sampled grid sizes of 6..30 by 8..30. One to four top sources, each 1-2 cells long, with columns at least 3 apart. Horizontal bars of length 2..2/3 of the width, including bars touching the edges, which produce clipped branches. Optional vertical bars, which are wrapped as width-1 runs. Bars are biased to intercept source columns. Not supported in random scenes: touching or L-shaped obstacle clusters, bars adjacent to sources, and sources longer than 2. Such combinations appear in the fixtures, which are reproduced from explicit segment lists.
authored_constraints: Random obstacles are 8-separated from each other and from source cells. Wrap rows and split start cells are therefore never red, and every horizontal run equals a single latent segment.
Bars are placed on rows >= 1, so a wrap row always exists inside the grid.
Source columns are at least 3 apart, and only source cells are magenta in the input.
Each sample must contain at least 2 wrap events, so the output differs nontrivially from the input.
Colours are fixed: background 7, walls 2, streams 6.
